title: Native Ringed Restriction Equivalence
statement: An equivalence of categories carrying the indicated dense-subsite topologies induces the equivalence of module sheaves over a commutative ring sheaf and its restriction. Its structural ring maps are the original equivalence unit and counit maps. Direct module restriction is isomorphic to the forward structural functor and hence is an equivalence, without identifying site and coefficient universes. Dependencies: [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-hom].

proof.text: the two functors differ only by identity restriction of scalars, whose canonical natural isomorphism transports the equivalence.
